verdict.rationale: Gladia documents a live speech-to-text quickstart. An init call returns a connectable URL and session id that clients can stream to and reconnect with, and the service returns partial and final transcripts in real time. Live-specific settings such as silence thresholds and utterance duration are configurable, and the default model supports live mode. Missing for 10: explicit naming of the WebSocket protocol and audio/message format details in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time latency.
